C1357.title: Earning Farm Reentrancy Attack Incident
C1357.summary: On August 9, 2023, DeFi project Earning Farm suffered a reentrancy attack, with different sources reporting losses from about 286,000 to 530,000 US dollars. Attackers exploited reentrancy and abnormal handling of shares/LP token ENF_ETHLEV, causing shares to be overwritten in the fallback flow and extracting assets, exposing risks in state updates and share accounting in yield aggregation contracts.
